commands: echo '=== IDENTITY ==='; git rev-parse HEAD; git status --short; uname -m; sysctl -n hw.ncpu; sysctl -n hw.memsize; ccache --version | head -n 1
rm -rf build/ccache-benchmark; mkdir -p build/ccache-benchmark; CCACHE_DIR=$PWD/build/ccache-benchmark ccache -z; echo '=== CLEAN_UNCACHED ==='; make clean-idf
echo '=== COLD_CACHE_FILL ==='; CCACHE_DIR=$PWD/build/ccache-benchmark IDF_CCACHE_ENABLE=1 /usr/bin/time -lp make build; CCACHE_DIR=$PWD/build/ccache-benchmark ccache -s
echo '=== COLD_CACHE_HIT ==='; CCACHE_DIR=$PWD/build/ccache-benchmark IDF_CCACHE_ENABLE=1 /usr/bin/time -lp make build; CCACHE_DIR=$PWD/build/ccache-benchmark ccache -s
rm -rf build/ccache-benchmark; echo '=== FINAL ==='; git status --short
